annotations.title: List the posts an X ad account can promote

description: List the posts an X ad account can promote — promoted-only ones by default (timeline NULLCAST), or ORGANIC / ALL. Read-only, free.

adAccountId.description: X ad account id (list_x_ads_accounts); omit if only one is shared

asUserId.description: promotable user id whose posts to list; omit for the ad account's own user

timeline.description: NULLCAST = promoted-only posts (default); ORGANIC = organic posts; ALL = both

tweetType.description: post state filter: DRAFT, PUBLISHED or SCHEDULED; omit for all

name: list_x_ads_posts
title: List the posts an X ad account can promote
